data.name: Khalis
data.gender_notes: Khalis is used as a male name in Islamic naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Derived from the Arabic root 'kh-l-s' which means to be clean, pure, or virtuous. The name Khalis carries the meaning “Pure, clean, virtuous” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic, Urdu, Persian. Parents who choose Khalis usually hope their child will grow to embody pure, clean, virtuous and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: A name for a child who is pure in heart, mind, and soul. It reflects a deep connection to the divine and a strong commitment to leading a simple, honest life.
data.etymology: Khalis belongs to the Arabic linguistic tradition and is used in Islamic naming. Its recorded meaning is “Pure, clean, virtuous.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Khalis total 6, giving a life-path number of 6. Number 6 is linked with Venus and with the qualities of responsibility, care and community.

in_arabic.name: خَلِيس
in_arabic.long_meaning: الخَلِيس: المُتَوَقَّع، المُتَطَلِب. يُعرّف الخَلِيس في اللغة العربية بأنَّهَ المُتَوَقَّع للثَناءِ، وَهُوَ مَصَدر الخَلاء، وَهُوَ فعل مُنَطَق، والخَلاء: التَوقُّع، وَالخَلِيسان: المُتَوَقَّعان. وفي الحديث النبوي: "الخَلِيسان مَنزِران، الخَلِيسان مَنزِران". يُعتَقَد في العُرف أنَّ الخَلِيس هو المُتَوَقَّع، المُتَطَلِب، وَفيه إِبَلاَغ إِلَيهِ، وَهُوَ بِمَعْنى الخَلاء، وَهُوَ تَقَدِيم النائِب إِلَيهِ، وَهُوَ مِنَ التَّوقُّف. وَفيه فعلان مُقارَنَة، وَهُمَا الخَلاء والخَلِيس، وَهُوَ مَصَدر الخَلاء، وَهُوَ مَصَدر الخَلِيساً. وَقَد نَقلَ البُخَارِيُّ فِي الصَحِيحِ: "الخَلِيسان مَنزِران، الخَلِيسان مَنزِران "، فَفيه تَقَدِيم النائِب إِلَيهِ، وَهُوَ مِنَ التَّوقُّف، وَقَد نَقلَ التِرمِذِيُّ فِي السُنَنِ: "الخَلِيسان مَنزِران، الخَلِيسان مَنزِران "، فَفيه مَصَدر الخَلِيس، وَهُوَ مَصَدر الخَلاء. وَفيه تَقَدِيم النائِب إِلَيهِ، وَهُوَ مِنَ التَّوقُّف. وَحَدَّثَ أَنَّ النبِيَّ صَلَّى اللَهُ عَلَيهِ وَسَلَّمَ: "إِنَّ اللَهَ يَقُولُ: إِنَّ مِن دَونِ in_english.name: Khalis
in_english.long_meaning: Khalis is an Arabic name that means single, solitary, exclusive, or unique. In Islamic tradition, Khalis refers to someone who is alone, distinct, or unaccompanied. The name Khalis is derived from the Arabic root "kh-l-s," which means to be alone or solitary. In Islamic theology, Khalis is used to describe the state of being alone with God, free from distractions and worldly concerns. The name Khalis is also associated with qualities such as purity, innocence, and simplicity. In Islamic culture, Khalis is considered a name that conveys a sense of spirituality, humility, and dedication to one's faith.

In many Arab and Muslim communities, the name "Khalis" is bestowed upon children as a source of inspiration and a reminder to live a life that is true to Islamic values and principles.

It is a name that is deeply rooted in the teachings of the Islamic faith and is closely associated with the ideals of Tawheed (monotheism) and Akhlaq (good conduct). By bearing this name, one is reminded of the importance of striving for a pure and virtuous character, and of the ultimate goal of seeking the pleasure and closeness of Allah (God) through good deeds and righteous actions. In this sense, the name "Khalis" serves as a constant reminder and source of inspiration for the bearer to live a life that is pleasing to God and in accordance with Islamic principles.
